contact_edits.before: Each was seen as an improvement on its predecessor for dramatic sophistication, and that claim is true. Each has also been called a breakthrough in musical style, and don't you believe it. Songs that don't tell the story or develop the characters have been with us nearly as long as Wedekind's play. And did you know --I wonder if the authors of the show do -- that he was a singer-songwriter himself? - Spring Awakening runs indefinitely at the Eugene O'Neill Theater, New York City.
